storylines.title: LeBron James confirms he nearly joined the Knicks, will live part-time in New York while playing for 76ers
storylines.summary: James, who made his public debut in a 76ers jersey on Monday, likely would have signed with the Knicks if they hadn't won it all in June

storylines.title: Knicks Prioritizing Center For Final Roster Spot
storylines.summary: The New York Knicks are looking to sign a center for the team's final roster spot, sources told Stefan Bondy of the New York Post. The Knicks recently signed Tony Bradley after waiving John Konchar. Bradley will join Drew Eubanks and James Wiseman in training camp.

storylines.summary: The Knicks are prioritizing a center with their 14th standard roster spot, according to Stefan Bondy of The New York Post (subscriber link), who says James Wiseman has emerged as the frontrunner to make the team out of training camp.
